scope: At most two lightweight continuation batches against the corrected residual queue; protected snapshots excluded.
stop_conditions: Any frozen queue or repository digest changes.
Any provider attempt lacks authoritative usage metadata, even if a retry later succeeds.
Either batch fails or any aggregate/per-batch ceiling is exhausted.

claim_boundary.connectivity: A clean retry is evidence only that these calls completed; it does not prove general network or provider reliability.
claim_boundary.prior_authorization: Prior authorization is not reused; prior attempts and costs remain separately accounted.
claim_boundary.protected_pair: Neither protected serialize-javascript snapshot is authorized.
